maddeler.e:
انمحيت (form VII)
# اِنْمَحَيْتُ (inmaḥaytu) /in.ma.ħaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
# اِنْمَحَيْتَ (inmaḥayta) /in.ma.ħaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
# اِنْمَحَيْتِ (inmaḥayti) /in.ma.ħaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
